name: Biodiv'Sport Grant Programme
summary: Yearly call for established biodiversity NGOs, with first grants of up to EUR 5,000 for projects involving IUCN-threatened species; the 2026 edition only took projects linking sport and conservation.

amount.note: Maximum for a first application; later grants may be higher

steps: Scoring by five evaluators, if retained

eligibility.rule: Being a civil society organisation dedicated to endangered species and ecosystem conservation
Operating legally for at least 3 years
Running a biodiversity project that protects an endangered species and raises awareness through sport
Targeting at least one IUCN Red List species classified as Vulnerable, Endangered or Critically Endangered
Requesting no more than 50% of annual budget and at least 10% of total project cost
Not transferring funds or re-granting to another organisation
Not locating the project in an armed conflict zone or restricted region

documents: Accounts for the last closed fiscal year approved by the Board
Progress report on the 2026 project, if it already exists

calls.label: Biodiv'Sport 2026 edition

status.quote: The next edition will run from 15 July to 16 August 2026.

opens.quote: The next edition will run from 15 July to 16 August 2026.

deadline.quote: The next edition will run from 15 July to 16 August 2026.

calls.note: 2026 edition only funded projects combining sport and conservation

applicant_types.quote: Your organisation is a civil society organisation (CSO) whose primary mission is biodiversity conservation, with a track record of actions demonstrating this commitment

access.quote: You are a biodiversity conservation NGO and would like to submit a project to be funded ? Find below our calls for proposals and how to apply!

window.quote: Every year, we provide technical and financial support to associations that carry out biodiversity conservation projects on the four continents.

amount.quote: For a first application, projects must be designed around a maximum grant of 5,000 €.

consortium_required.quote: Only civil society organizations dedicated to the conservation of endangered species and ecosystems will be considered, either alone or in coalition with a sports organization.

effort.quote: Opening of the call for projects and receipt of applications: from July 15, 2026 to August 16, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. (Paris time, GMT +2).
First, all applications are checked against the eligibility criteria - ineligible applications are not reviewed further.
all eligible applications (see sections 3, 4, 5) will undergo an initial scoring.
The applications retained after this stage will then be scored by 5 separate evaluators from the Selection Committee.
A shortlist of the highest-scoring applications will then be presented to the Committee at a dedicated meeting, at the end of which the awarded projects will be designated.

eligibility.quote: Only civil society organizations dedicated to the conservation of endangered species and ecosystems will be considered, either alone or in coalition with a sports organization.
The organization must have a minimum legal existence of 3 years.

It must be a biodiversity conservation project aimed at protecting an endangered species and raising awareness of its protection, through the practice of a sport or the organization of a sporting event.

Projects must concern the conservation or awareness-raising for the protection of at least one species listed on the IUCN Red List, in one of the following categories: Vulnerable, Endangered, or Critically Endangered.
The amount of support requested must not exceed 50% of the organization's annual budget, and must represent at least 10% of the total project cost.
The project must not involve any transfer of funds or re-granting to another organization.
The project must not be located in an armed conflict zone. For certain countries, this restriction applies to specific regions.

after_award.quote: If your project is selected, you will be expected to maintain regular communication with our team (including interim reports) and submit a final report using our template.

documents.quote: CV of the project leader(s) Provisional budget of the organization for 2026 * Accounts for the last closed fiscal year, approved by the Board of Directors (for example, for an application in 2026 for a 2027 grant, the 2025 accounts must be provided) Activity report of the organization for 2025.
Progress report on the 2026 project, if the project already exists.
project budget, project leader's CV, bank details, organisation logo
If yes, please attach the commitment letter from the co-funder(s)
